retests.observed: Clicking Alex’s Settle button immediately recorded the full EUR20 repayment. No review or amount-entry step appeared. This was a ledger record, not a money transfer.

The same account opened the same new event in two production tabs. Changing Going to Maybe in one tab left the second tab showing Going across subsequent checks. Reloading the second tab showed Maybe. This extends the earlier cross-client observation; it is not a separate defect or a conflicting-edit test.

images.alt: Second production tab still shows Going for the same event.

retests.observed: Creating QA Saturday hike returned to the Expenses tab. Selecting Events revealed the saved event. Returning from a past event also reset to Expenses in a read-only supplementary check on the alternate deployment; that check used a different account.
Submitting QA-invalid-review-code displayed Invalid invite code inside the Spanish interface. The form became usable again; no group was joined.

images.alt: English invalid-code error within the Spanish join form.

additions.title: Production can fail to a blank page during deployment
additions.summary: Reloading the production members page and then the home URL produced a blank screen. The console reported missing Supabase configuration. The user restored the deployment; a fresh tab subsequently loaded and saved records normally.
additions.verify: Recovered in this session. Retain the incident as evidence, not an assertion of a current outage. Check required configuration before publishing, smoke-test the home and a nested route, and provide a readable startup failure state.

images.alt: Blank production page during the configuration incident.
Production dashboard after recovery; an earlier balance checkpoint.

additions.title: A saved guest can remain absent from the current member list
additions.summary: Adding QA Alex and QA Bea cleared the input without showing the new member. Reopening the page revealed the saved guest. The browser tooling later logged a clipboard-bridge error, so the cause and normal foreground-browser reproduction remain uncertain.
additions.verify: Repeat manually with the app focused, including a failed or unavailable clipboard. Show the saved member and clear success feedback independently of invitation copying. Do not count this as proven data loss or a universal browser failure.

images.alt: After adding QA Bea, the current list still shows only the previously loaded members.

additions.title: Firebase reports missing configuration after the app recovers
additions.summary: The recovered production session logged FirebaseError: Installations: Missing App configuration value: projectId. Main ledger workflows remained usable. Notification permission and delivery were not tested.
additions.verify: Inspect the deployed Firebase configuration and then verify notification setup and delivery in an authorised test. The console error alone does not establish which notification paths fail.

additions.title: A longer group name causes desktop sidebar overflow
additions.summary: The longer QA — Weekend group review name produced horizontal scrolling in the desktop sidebar. The phone dashboard card wrapped the same name readably.
additions.verify: Constrain the desktop sidebar width and wrap or truncate names accessibly. Test long names without creating a horizontal scrollbar or hiding actions.

images.alt: Desktop sidebar shows horizontal overflow beside the long review-group name.

additions.title: CSV exports omit the shares needed to explain debts
additions.summary: The downloaded CSV correctly contained the two expenses and repayment at export time. Its columns were Date, Description, Category, Amount, Currency, Paid By and Settlement; participants and individual shares were absent.
additions.verify: Keep the simple expense-list export, and consider a detailed ledger export with participants and shares if independent debt reconciliation is a supported goal. This is an export scope limitation, not an observed download or arithmetic failure.

additions.title: The home screen lists groups but does not surface what needs attention
additions.summary: The production dashboard clearly shows group membership and each group’s net balance. The inspected home view did not show a combined agenda, separate totals owed and owing, or outstanding group actions. The user agrees that the centre should provide an immediate overview.
additions.verify: Design an actionable home view with explicit group and currency scope, separate owed/owing amounts, upcoming plans, and relevant actions. Retain a clear group switcher on mobile. Proposed dashboard features are not implemented or independently verified capabilities.

images.alt: Final production phone dashboard: three groups and EUR34 owed in the review group.
